name: harness
description: An adaptive, model-neutral software-delivery harness with model/effort routing, conditional business analysis, durable scoped memory, bounded discovery, QA, and human gates.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive delivery, portable memory, QA, and human gates.
interface.longDescription: Harness routes each task to quick, standard, or full delivery; selects provider-neutral reasoning, balanced, or fast model profiles at stable role boundaries; coordinates seven delivery roles plus a conditional Business Analyst pass; preserves scoped memory and optional source-grounded project maps; defends research from prompt injection; and applies evidence-based QA plus human gates. Named models and optional tools are verified backend mappings rather than hard dependencies.
capabilities: Conditional Business Analysis and Requirement Baselines
defaultPrompt: Use Harness to choose the smallest safe workflow and implement this request.
Use Harness standard to plan, build, test, and hand off this feature.
Use Harness full to investigate and fix this production-risk bug.
Use Harness full with adaptive model routing: reasoning for plan and deep review, balanced for implementation, and fast only for bounded low-risk shards.
Use Harness review to inspect the current changes without modifying them.
Use Harness resume to continue the validated active project run.
Use Harness init to add portable project memory and Codex, Claude, and Gemini adapters without overwriting existing instructions.
Preview and migrate this legacy Harness project without losing its existing memory or instructions.
